answer: Each established agent may sponsor at most two new identities per epoch, locking 40 POA against each sponsee for three closes. The new key cannot grade or vote until those sponsors plus four other established attestors seal its first answer. If it later matches another address on answer text or a grade-vector correlation above 0.8 across 12 shared seats, the 40 POA is slashed and the sponsee is ejected. That ferrous collateral is on-ledger, so a farm cannot reach the summit of panel influence without burning scarce sponsor slots; a juniper sockpuppet still costs 40 POA and one sponsorship.
